what_this_is: A re-run of the published history corpus, from the URLs in docs/corpus/history-corpus-2026-09-19.tsv, measured with scripts/measure_history.py. It exists because the README quoted figures that no published file backed, and because the manifest claimed surviving result files that could not be found on 26 September 2026.

unread_and_why.reason: the tool reported a missing optional package and said so plainly rather than blaming the file. Those 15 are excluded from every figure below.

what_this_does_not_say: No content recovered from any document appears here or was printed by the script.
The six documents behind Q4 are NOT named in this file. They are live published documents and the organisations that published them are being told first.
Q1 and Q3 are structural and ordinary. Only Q4 means what a reader assumes the first number means.
15 of 844 documents were not measured at all and every figure here is over 829, not 844.
reproduce_it: Fetch the URLs in docs/corpus/history-corpus-2026-09-19.tsv, then run scripts/measure_history.py over the directory. 834 of the 845 retrievable documents were byte identical to their published hash on this date, so the corpus itself verifies.
